name: MKL_LEAD_ACCESS
description: Denorm table for Lead Resources and Territories. This Denormed table is used to optimize the lead security predicates.

columns.name: LEAD_ACCESS_ID
columns.description: Lead Access Id which is Primary Key column

columns.name: LEAD_ID
columns.description: Lead Id to which the row belongs

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Contains either Resources Party Id or Territory Id based on Type column value

columns.name: TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Contains either RESOURCES or TERRITORIES value

columns.name: LEAD_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Lead Resource Id which is primary key column to MKL_LEAD_RESOURCES table

columns.name: LEAD_TERRITORY_ID
columns.description: Lead Territory Id which is primary key column to MKL_LEAD_TERRITORY table

columns.name: ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Access Level code of resource on lead for records with type RESOURCE or TERRITORY

columns.name: LEAD_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Effective Date which is a de-normalized column of Creation_Date in MKL_LM_LEADS

columns.name: LEAD_STATUS_CD
columns.description: Status Code which is a de-normalized column of Status Code in MKL_LM_LEADS

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
